flags.description: South Africa's Competition Commission is prosecuting Roche over allegedly excessive pricing of the breast cancer drug trastuzumab (Herceptin), estimating that around 10,000 women were unable to afford the roughly $32,000/year treatment between 2011 and 2019 as a result; the Commission has described the pricing as a violation of basic human rights and is seeking maximum penalties. This is an ongoing case, not yet concluded.
